summary: Gildan Activewear Inc. filed a Form 6-K announcing Q2 2026 results and the sale of HanesBrands Australia (HAA) for an enterprise value of approximately A$700 million (US$490 million). The transaction is expected to close in H2 2026, with proceeds used to reduce debt and accelerate return to target leverage of 1.5x-2.5x net debt/adjusted EBITDA. No advisors or board recommendation were disclosed. The sale is a strategic divestiture following the HanesBrands acquisition, complementing integration and synergy capture. Watch for regulatory approvals and closing conditions, with proceeds likely impacting leverage metrics and potential capital returns.
